notes: Cross-verse reconciliation with PRO.22.12. Both verses render a Hebrew with no possessive morpheme by an English relative expression of having that no morpheme licenses: 'He that hath a bountiful eye' here, 'him that hath knowledge' at 22.12. This verse partitioned the supplied words as two `added` units on rule 2's preference for the smallest unit; 22.12 kept the run as one. Rule 2 tests source-target allocation and does not reach English no morpheme owns, and rules 20, 33 and 43 place a supplied word together with whatever the ASV supplies alongside it, so the run is one `added` unit headed on 'hath'. Nothing else in the verse changes.
